title: narcissus nivalis var. granatensis
intro: Narcissus nivalis var. granatensis, commonly known as the Granada snowdrop, is a subspecies of the Narcissus nivalis, a species of flowering plant in the Amaryllidaceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include its potential to provide relief from anxiety and stress due to its health benefits, such as antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Narcissus nivalis var. granatensis include its ability to calm the nervous system and promote relaxation, making it a potential natural remedy for insomnia and other sleep disorders. The bioactive constituents of this plant include galantamine, which is a cholinesterase inhibitor, and other alkaloids and flavonoids that contribute to its therapeutic properties.
